Having uttered these words, the great Sage Vishwamitta

They said : " The dynssty of Kusha has ever practised

Thus did the great sages praise the Rishi Vishwamitra, who

brief.summary_1line: Vishwamitra recounts his lineage to Rama: Kushanabha’s son Gadhi is his father, and his sister Satyavati becomes the sacred Kaushiki river.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyavati ascends to heaven and transforms into the shining Kaushiki river flowing near the Himalayas.
Under a star-filled night sky in the forest, sage Vishwamitra sits with Rama and Lakshmana, finishing the tale of his lineage.
